acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI can add, edit, refresh, cancel, and retry a provider profile while preserving the last valid state.
The TUI presents only models supported by the selected connected provider and explains unavailable states.
Missing credentials, signatures, or key management produce visible development-only warnings and never block setup or offline execution.
API keys and raw provider responses never appear in UI state, JSON output, or evidence.

definition_of_done: Focused UI-model and control-journey tests pass.
Independent exact-head review and hosted checks pass.
